text:
maria: Quick sync — we had ~30% increase in inbound leads Sat night, a bunch ended up unassigned. Need a short playbook for routing + SLA. Anyone free?
jack: saw that, looks like HubSpot enrichment TTL expired for ~120 leads. I'll pull logs.
sam: cc @ellie @devon — could this be the round-robin deadlock again?
ellie: yup, round-robin queue hit a race with claim throttle. Fix we had last month didn't apply to new hs pipeline.
jack: proposed immediate mitigation: 1) extend enrichment TTL to 10m, 2) temp fallback owner pool 'oncall-marketing', 3) disable strict claim throttle for src=web.
maria: ok, can we turn on fallback now? if so, who executes?
devon: I can flip fallback; deploying a small workflow change in HubSpot. @hubspot-bot will show deploy.
deploy-bot: HubSpot workflow 'Inbound RR + Fallback' deployed by devon at 2248005600 :white_check_mark: 
ellie: long term playbook draft:
- Detect enrichment delays > 2m -> route to fallback pool
- If claim attempts > 3 and unassigned for 5m -> escalate to SDR queue
- Postmortem if unassigned > 15m
KPI: P95 handoff time <= 5m
sam: can we add a guard that avoids sending to fallback for enterprise leads? should respect lead.tier == 'enterprise'
jack: yes, add HS condition. snippet:
```
if lead.tier == 'enterprise' then assign owner = 'ent-ops' else round_robin()
```
maria: love it. ellie, can you write final playbook doc? aim to send to sales by EOD. Also schedule a 15m ops standup tomorrow at 10:15 to monitor.
ellie: will do. I'll ping #sales and update the playbook doc. assigning owner: ellie
sam: +1. thanks team :thumbsup:
